source: The Circa Dataset (Annie Louis, Dan Roth, Filip Radlinski / Google LLC)
adaptation: 日常の好みを尋ねる質問を選び、日本語に翻訳・二択表示へ調整

translations.original: Are you a fan of Korean food?
Would you like to get some fresh air in your free time?
translations.japanese: 休日は外で過ごしたい？

translations.original: Do you like to read self-help books?
translations.japanese: 自己啓発本を読むのは好き？

translations.original: Do you enjoy foreign cuisine?
Are long books your thing?
Do you enjoy playing any sports?
translations.japanese: スポーツをするのは好き？

translations.original: Do you play the guitar?
Do you want to have a BBQ this evening?
translations.japanese: 今夜バーベキューをしたい？

translations.original: Will you be working tomorrow?
translations.japanese: 明日は仕事や学校がある？

translations.original: Do you enjoy art?
Do you like travelling?
Do you like fantasy books?
translations.japanese: ファンタジー小説は好き？

translations.original: Do you like jazz music?
Do you still like hiking?
Are you in the mood for ramen?
translations.japanese: ラーメンを食べたい気分？

translations.original: Are you a big meat-eater?

translations.original: Looking forward to this weekend?
Want to go dancing tomorrow night?
translations.japanese: 明日の夜に踊りに行きたい？

translations.original: Do you play golf on weekends?
Do you watch a lot of romance movies?
Have you ever read horror novel books?
translations.japanese: ホラー小説を読んだことがある？

translations.original: Do you like a variety of food?
translations.japanese: いろいろな国の料理を食べたい？

translations.original: Do you want some time on your own to explore?

translations.original: Have you been to a concert this month?
translations.japanese: 最近コンサートに行った？

translations.original: Do you like steak?

translations.japanese: 予定はきっちり決めたい？

Do you often listen to pop music?
translations.japanese: ポップ音楽をよく聴く？

translations.original: Want to grab a drink?
